blocks.text: Dennis Trillo got netizens talking anew after he shared a cryptic remark about washing one’s hands in a “sewer,” after Patrick Garcia’s tell-all about his past relationship with Jennylyn Mercado. Trillo — who married Mercado in 2021 and soon after legally adopted her and Garcia’s child Alex Jazz — shared the post via his TikTok page on Wednesday, Sept. 30. “Kapag naghugas ka ng kamay sa kanal, lalo lang dudumi,” he wrote as his Memo No. 01, with the post featuring the song “Tabing Ilog” by Barbie’s Cradle.
